\(9r(r-s)^2(r+2s)\)

Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of the following expressions:
\(8p^2-12pq-8q^2\)
\(p^3-p^2q-2pq^2\)
\(4p^2q+6pq^2+2q^3\)

求以下各式的最大公因式及最小公倍式：
\(8p^2-12pq-8q^2\)
\(p^3-p^2q-2pq^2\)
\(4p^2q+6pq^2+2q^3\)

The factorizations are \(4(2p+q)(p-2q)\), \(p(p-2q)(p+q)\) and \(2q(2p+q)(p+q)\). No factor is shared by all three. Use every distinct factor once and coefficient lcm 4.
H.C.F.: \(1\).
L.C.M.: \[\begin{gathered}4pq \cdot(p+q) \\ \cdot(p-2q) \\ \cdot(2p+q)\end{gathered}\].

三式分別為 \(4(2p+q)(p-2q)\)、\(p(p-2q)(p+q)\)、\(2q(2p+q)(p+q)\)。沒有三式共有的因式；最小公倍式取全部相異因式各一次，係數取 4。
最大公因式：\(1\)。
最小公倍式：\[\begin{gathered}4pq \cdot(p+q) \\ \cdot(p-2q) \\ \cdot(2p+q)\end{gathered}\]。

fields.after: The H.C.F. and L.C.M. of three polynomials are \(4x^2-4x+1\) and \[\begin{gathered}36(2x-1)^3 \\ \cdot(2x+1)^4 \\ \cdot(2x+3)^2\end{gathered}\] respectively. Two of them are \(4(2x-1)^2(2x+1)^3\) and \(6(2x-1)^2(2x+3)\). Find the third.
三多項式的最大公因式及最小公倍式分別為 \(4x^2-4x+1\) 及 \[\begin{gathered}36(2x-1)^3 \\ \cdot(2x+1)^4 \\ \cdot(2x+3)^2\end{gathered}\]。其中兩式為 \(4(2x-1)^2(2x+1)^3\) 及 \(6(2x-1)^2(2x+3)\)，求第三式。

The H.C.F. is \((2x-1)^2\). For coefficients, the third positive coefficient must have lcm 36 with 4 and 6 and gcd 1 with them, hence it is 9. The third expression must supply the missing maximum powers 3,4,2 of the three bracket factors. Thus it is \[\begin{gathered}9(2x-1)^3 \\ \cdot(2x+1)^4 \\ \cdot(2x+3)^2\end{gathered}\]. Checking all three gives the stated H.C.F. and L.C.M.
最大公因式為 \((2x-1)^2\)。第三式的正係數與 4、6 的最小公倍數須為 36、最大公因數須為 1，因此為 9。三個括號因式的最高指數 3、4、2 均須由第三式提供，故為 \[\begin{gathered}9(2x-1)^3 \\ \cdot(2x+1)^4 \\ \cdot(2x+3)^2\end{gathered}\]。代回三式核對可得原定的最大公因式及最小公倍式。

fields.after:
Two degree-2 polynomials have H.C.F. \(3x-2\) and L.C.M. \(6x^3+5x^2-3x-2\).
(a) Factorise the L.C.M.
(b) Find the two polynomials.

兩個二次多項式的最大公因式為 \(3x-2\)，最小公倍式為 \(6x^3+5x^2-3x-2\)。
(a) 把最小公倍式因式分解。
(b) 求兩個多項式。

(a) \[\begin{gathered}6x^3 +5x^2 -3x -2 \\ =(3x-2)(2x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\].
(b) Each quadratic contains the common linear factor and one of the other factors. The standard primitive representatives are \[\begin{gathered}(3x-2)(2x+1) =6x^2 \\ -x -2\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}(3x-2)(x+1) =3x^2 \\ +x -2\end{gathered}\] (in either order). Nonzero scalar multiples are equivalent if H.C.F./L.C.M. are defined only up to units.

(a) \[\begin{gathered}6x^3 +5x^2 -3x -2 \\ =(3x-2)(2x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]。
(b) 每個二次式包含共同的一次因式及餘下其中一個因式。取標準本原代表，兩式為 \[\begin{gathered}(3x-2)(2x+1) =6x^2 \\ -x -2\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}(3x-2)(x+1) =3x^2 \\ +x -2\end{gathered}\]，次序可互換。若公因式／公倍式只定義至非零常數倍，則相應常數倍視為等價。

fields.after:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =4x^3 -24x^2 \\ +17x +15\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6x^3 -35x^2 \\ +19x +30\end{gathered}\].
(a) Show that \(2x-3\) is a common factor.
(b) Factorise both polynomials.
(c) Find their H.C.F. and L.C.M.

設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =4x^3 -24x^2 \\ +17x +15\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6x^3 -35x^2 \\ +19x +30\end{gathered}\]。
(a) 證明 \(2x-3\) 是公因式。
(b) 把兩式因式分解。
(c) 求它們的最大公因式及最小公倍式。

(a) Direct substitution gives \(f(3/2)=g(3/2)=0\), so \(2x-3\) divides both.
(b) Division gives \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x-3)(2x^2-9x-5) \\ =(2x-3)(x-5)(2x+1)\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(2x-3)(3x^2-13x-10) \\ =(2x-3)(x-5)(3x+2)\end{gathered}\].
(c) H.C.F. \((2x-3)(x-5)\); L.C.M. \[\begin{gathered}(2x-3) \cdot(x-5) \\ \cdot(2x+1) \\ \cdot(3x+2)\end{gathered}\].

(a) 直接代入得 \(f(3/2)=g(3/2)=0\)，故 \(2x-3\) 是公因式。
(b) 相除後得 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x-3)(2x^2-9x-5) \\ =(2x-3)(x-5)(2x+1)\end{gathered}\]，\[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(2x-3)(3x^2-13x-10) \\ =(2x-3)(x-5)(3x+2)\end{gathered}\]。
(c) 最大公因式為 \((2x-3)(x-5)\)；最小公倍式為 \[\begin{gathered}(2x-3) \cdot(x-5) \\ \cdot(2x+1) \\ \cdot(3x+2)\end{gathered}\]。

fields.after:
It is given that \(3x+1\) is a common factor of \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =12x^3 +49x^2 \\ +mx -n\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6nx^3 -34x^2 \\ -5x +m\end{gathered}\], where \(m,n\) are constants.
(a) Find \(m,n\).
(b) Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of \(f(x),g(x)\).

已知 \(3x+1\) 是 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =12x^3 +49x^2 \\ +mx -n\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6nx^3 -34x^2 \\ -5x +m\end{gathered}\] 的公因式，其中 \(m,n\) 為常數。
(a) 求 \(m,n\)。
(b) 求兩式的最大公因式及最小公倍式。

(a) Set \(x=-1/3\). The equations reduce to \(m+3n=15\) and \(9m-2n=19\), giving \(m=3,n=4\).
(b) Factor to get \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(x+4)\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(2x-3)\end{gathered}\]. H.C.F. \((3x+1)(4x-1)\); L.C.M. \[\begin{gathered}(3x+1) \cdot(4x-1) \\ \cdot(x+4) \\ \cdot(2x-3)\end{gathered}\].

(a) 代 \(x=-1/3\)，兩式化為 \(m+3n=15\)、\(9m-2n=19\)，得 \(m=3,n=4\)。
(b) 因式分解得 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(x+4)\end{gathered}\]、\[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(2x-3)\end{gathered}\]。最大公因式為 \((3x+1)(4x-1)\)，最小公倍式為 \[\begin{gathered}(3x+1) \cdot(4x-1) \\ \cdot(x+4) \\ \cdot(2x-3)\end{gathered}\]。

en.text: It is given that \(3x+1\) is a common factor of \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =12x^3 +49x^2 \\ +mx -n\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6nx^3 -34x^2 \\ -5x +m\end{gathered}\], where \(m,n\) are constants.
(b) Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of \(f(x),g(x)\).

zh-Hant.text: 已知 \(3x+1\) 是 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =12x^3 +49x^2 \\ +mx -n\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6nx^3 -34x^2 \\ -5x +m\end{gathered}\] 的公因式，其中 \(m,n\) 為常數。
(b) 求兩式的最大公因式及最小公倍式。

en.text: (a) Set \(x=-1/3\). The equations reduce to \(m+3n=15\) and \(9m-2n=19\), giving \(m=3,n=4\).

(b) Factor to get \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(x+4)\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(2x-3)\end{gathered}\]. H.C.F. \((3x+1)(4x-1)\); L.C.M. \[\begin{gathered}(3x+1) \cdot(4x-1) \\ \cdot(x+4) \\ \cdot(2x-3)\end{gathered}\].

zh-Hant.text: (b) 因式分解得 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(x+4)\end{gathered}\]、\[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(2x-3)\end{gathered}\]。最大公因式為 \((3x+1)(4x-1)\)，最小公倍式為 \[\begin{gathered}(3x+1) \cdot(4x-1) \\ \cdot(x+4) \\ \cdot(2x-3)\end{gathered}\]。
